content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WDRA Consultant (Legal) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.wdra.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by WDRA?
faq.answer: WDRA has advertised for the post of Consultant (Legal) under advertisement number A-03000310/1/2023- A and F/787.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Legal) position offered through this official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Consultant (Legal)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LL.B. degree from a recognized University or Institution along with the required post-qualification professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Consultant (Legal) position is 64 years as specified in the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 28 October 2026. Applications must reach before this date.

faq.question: Q7. Through which mode can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode only by sending the filled proforma via post or courier to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or remuneration for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary equivalent to 50% of the last pay drawn at the time of their retirement from service.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for WDRA Consultant (Legal)?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on specific criteria followed by an interview conducted by the authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application must be sent to the Deputy Director (HR), Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority, NCUI Building, Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110016.
